{{Quote|Jurithus was once owned by an anti-government radical who used slaves to carry messages to like-minded dissidents.|Lodenth Kashar briefs Cipher Nine on Jurithus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jurithus''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] who was sold into slavery on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he, along with [[Sathun]], [[Avoira]], and [[Rennith]], joined a group of slave rebels to fight against their [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] slavers and escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, he and his friends were all killed in the skirmish.
